message.content:
A full-length vertical editorial illustration features a red background with white and yellow text. At the top, "TEMPO" is written in large, white, serif capital letters. Above it, smaller white text reads "MENENGOK ENERGI TERBARUKAN" and "PAUS YESUIT PERTAMA" separated by a thin white diagonal line. Below the main title is "EDISI 18-24 MARET 2013" in small black text. 

Dominating the lower three-quarters is a person's torso and head. The person has short dark hair and is wearing a short-sleeved, collared button-up shirt with a textured fabric pattern. The figure is turned slightly towards the right and looks forward with a neutral expression. In their hands, they hold a dark-colored machine with a barrel, a stock, and a handgrip, positioned diagonally across their body. The person's left hand grips the handgrip while the right hand rests near the trigger area. 

To the left of the person, large yellow capital letters read "SBY DAN HANTU KUDETA". At the bottom left, small black text includes "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00003".
